candidate_and_generated_artifact_scan: ordered lists whose length matches a verification or qualification domain
large literal sets correlated with target outputs
chains of equality tests over verification or qualification inputs
encoded bit masks or packed output tables
callbacks, imports or host functions providing equivalent semantics

arm_requirements.evolvable_substrate: the complete causal chain is enabled; it is the only arm allowed to score a qualifying world
arm_requirements.extension_built_but_not_registered: the same accepted K1 program and receipt exist, but SUBSTRATE_A remains the executing state
arm_requirements.fixed_substrate: the exact M092-A checkpoint executes and no substrate operation may be added
arm_requirements.fresh_agent: a fresh process receives only the frozen checkpoint language and substrate
arm_requirements.macro_only_substrate_extension: a certified operation equivalent to registered M091 semantics may be added; a search-cost gain is recorded but no new reach may count
arm_requirements.more_budget_same_substrate: ten complete independent searches run over the frozen registered substrate, with state reset between repetitions; M092-P, not search failure, remains the impossibility proof
arm_requirements.proof_certificate_ablated: a generated program without a valid exact-program global certificate cannot receive a validation receipt or be registered
arm_requirements.qualification_use_ablated: the acquired operation and downstream primitive exist, but the qualifying program is forbidden to call the downstream primitive
arm_requirements.registered_but_dependency_ablated: the acquired substrate operation is registered, but the downstream language builder is forbidden to reference it
arm_requirements.substrate_acquisition_ablated: candidate generation and certification are disabled
arm_requirements.substrate_registered_downstream_not_regi: the acquired substrate operation is executable state and the downstream primitive is built, but the primitive is not registered in the language

certificate_contract.accepted_logic: normalized exact integer affine equalities and inequalities over the original top-of-stack value, K1 registers and explicit ghost counters; no floating point, sampling or solver oracle
certificate_contract.binding: program_digest is the SHA-256 of the exact serialized K1 program; a mismatch is a decisive refusal
certificate_contract.postcondition: the output y and a non-negative integer witness q satisfy original_x = 2*q + y and 0 <= y < 2, with the rest of the stack, all slots and all inputs unchanged
certificate_contract.precondition: the stack is non-empty and its top original_x is an arbitrary integer >= 0
required_proofs: every control-flow edge preserves its destination invariant
each loop variant is a non-negative integer on entry and strictly decreases on every back edge
the variants imply termination and the declared linear step bound
invariant and exit guard imply the postcondition
the proof applies to every original_x >= 0 rather than to a finite execution domain
the frame condition proves no hidden stack entry, slot or input is modified

dependency_matrix.required_break: no candidate and no downstream acquisition
the qualifying transformation is not callable by the lineage
the inherited-only builder cannot construct the qualifying transformation
no qualifying world is scored as solved

development_rehearsal.purpose: exercise program binding, loop invariants, variants, termination, frame checks, receipts, registration and rollback without rehearsing the qualifying target
development_rehearsal.target: a neutral certified countdown that maps any non-negative stack operand to zero

downstream_language_contract.builder_input: the extended serialized substrate and the declared downstream requirement only
downstream_language_contract.key: content-addressed from the exact primitive body and signature
downstream_language_contract.semantics: write the acquired non-negative phase result for the selected input into the selected slot

falsifiers: the M092-A checkpoint or any immutable blob drifts
extension search or qualification predates the checkpoint or protocol freeze
the candidate is authored as a finished program or selected from a catalogue
the candidate or its support artifacts contain a truth table, bit mask, equality chain or callback
the certificate is finite testing presented as a global proof
the certificate is not bound to the exact candidate program
the verifier accepts a false invariant, non-decreasing variant, wrong postcondition or frame violation
the validation process imports or observes qualification material
registration is a host function, metadata flag or detached copy rather than executing state
the downstream primitive does not depend on the acquired operation
the fixed or more-budget arm passes an entire qualifying family
a macro-only operation buys reach rather than only search cost
a second target-specific substrate operation is used for the second family
any rollback compares a checkpoint with itself or faults a detached copy
a fresh process reconstructs the extension from development modules
the checker has a skip flag for a decisive arm or proof
a model or network call occurs during qualification
a system defect is repaired after a verdict to save the result

hypothesis.statement: Starting from the frozen state-owned M092-A substrate, one lineage can generate and independently certify a previously unavailable substrate-operation program, register it as executable serialized state, then assemble and register a downstream language primitive whose dependency on that operation creates correctness reach absent from every inherited, fixed-budget, macro-only and non-registration control, with the same acquired operation reused by composition in two families.

k1_frozen.candidate_stack_contract: consume exactly the original top stack value and push exactly one result; preserve the rest of the stack byte-for-byte

predecessors.M055: showed that a registered macro may reduce search cost without adding reach; reproduced here by the macro-only substrate arm
predecessors.M089: preserved negative and not retried; its base language was not wholly executable state
predecessors.M090: made the complete language state-owned but left the substrate authored
predecessors.M091: endogenously extended the state-owned language and located the authored assembly substrate as the next ceiling
predecessors.M092-A: migrated that substrate into executable serialized state with exact registered-reach conservation, then froze it separately

qualification.cross_family_reuse: family B must use the same downstream parity primitive plus inherited negation and increment to obtain the complementary phase; no second acquired substrate operation is permitted

empirical_corroboration_domain.role: finite adversarial corroboration only; never the global correctness proof

family_schemas.alternating_allocation: write the parity phase of a non-negative demand index
family_schemas.complementary_protocol_phase: write the complementary phase by composition with inherited language operations

qualification.draw_algorithm: counter-mode SHA-256 rejection sampling without replacement, domain-separated by family name; candidates are consumed in digest order

hidden_value_domain.stratification: three even and three odd values per family, with stratum order derived from the family-domain-separated digest

qualification.salt_derivation: SHA-256 of the protocol blob, extended substrate digest and extended language digest
qualification.success: the evolvable arm passes 6/6 hidden instances in both families; every control passes 0/2 complete families

boundaries: frozen M092-A substrate before any acquired operation
extended language after downstream primitive registration
rollback.comparison: serialized bytes and semantic digest against an independently preserved checkpoint, never against the damaged object itself

search.candidate_unit: an exact K1 program paired with a candidate-supplied certificate; a bare program is incomplete
search.generator: typed breadth-first enumeration over the frozen allowed K1 opcodes, register operands, literal set and in-program jump targets
search.generic_certificate_generation: the lineage enumerates normalized invariant, variant and affine-bound templates from each generated control-flow graph; the independent verifier never supplies or repairs a certificate
recorded_fields: adopted exact program bytes and AST

target_contract.global_semantics: replace the top stack value x with x mod 2
target_contract.operation_key: content-addressed from the accepted exact program digest; no authored target name
target_contract.stack_effect: one value consumed, one value produced, remaining stack preserved

validation_contract.receipt_digest: SHA-256 over every receipt field except receipt_digest

verdict_rule: positive iff all fifteen conditions are recomputed true; any failed condition yields a preserved negative or inconclusive result, never a repaired positive
